name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
narrative.objectives: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
narrative.offerRewardText: What's this, Khalerenn? Tracking kobolds?Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

mentionedItems.name: Kobold Tracking Kit
tooltip: Use: Causes nearby kobold tracks to appear on your map.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 2 to 7, 2,630 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

quests.objectiveText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

quests.objectiveText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
